text.p: These are the highlights of main stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ministry of Economy to present to the government on Monday a report on market supply, evaluation of shortages of some products and possibility to influence prices of some of them which unjustifiably went up after the devaluation of the denar.

- Macedonia needs to make changes in customs regulations according to terms of the approved SAL credit. Customs to be the responsibility of the finance ministry and will not operate as a separate service.

- Macedonian telecommunications denies Thursday's press reports that tax for cellular phones would drop to 360 German marks. General manager Risto Mickov said the cellular phone price has already gone down with the denar devaluation and is the equivalent of 450 German marks. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
